_comment: An example mod made of one Lua script. Copy this folder into user-content/ to try it. docs/anotherworld/design-lua.md lists the API.
name: Loot Tweaks
author: OB64: Another World
description: Hawkman drops a Short Sword, a Heal Leaf found or bought becomes a Heal Seed, and every item the army receives is written to the log. An example of a script that changes a record and reacts to a game event.
